text:
Can you name all 10 segments of the right lung? 🧠 Just remember: A PALM Seed Makes Another Little Palm
Right lung bronchopulmonary segments mnemonic: A PALM Seed Makes Another Little Palm = 10 segments (upper 3 + middle 2 + lower 5)
A = Apical (upper lobe)
P = Posterior (upper lobe)
A = Anterior (upper lobe)
L = Lateral (middle lobe)
M = Medial (middle lobe)
S = Superior (lower lobe)
M = Medial basal (lower lobe)
A = Anterior basal (lower lobe)
L = Lateral basal (lower lobe)
P = Posterior basal (lower lobe)
Quick test: which lobe has only two segments? Answer in the video.
Save this for your next anatomy exam.
Images: Gray's Anatomy (1918), Fig. 962, public domain; diagrams: Book Plume
